==> /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml <==
flannel-iface: eth1
node-ip: 10.0.0.4
node-name: node3
server: https://10.0.0.2:6443
token: the-token

==> /etc/rancher/k3s/registries.yaml <==
mirrors:
    registry.test:
        endpoint:
            - http://10.0.0.2:5001

==> /etc/systemd/system/k3s-agent.service.d/memory.conf <==
[Service]
Environment=GOMEMLIMIT=1600MiB

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/kubelet.conf.d/10-moostack.conf <==
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
evictionHard:
    memory.available: 800Mi
kind: KubeletConfiguration
kubeReserved:
    memory: 250Mi
systemReserved:
    memory: 200Mi
